name: misty-mountain-hot-spring
image_purpose: Travel destination and wellness lifestyle content

prompt.project_info: Create a calm smartphone travel portrait at an outdoor mountain hot spring, balancing warm water and cool misty air.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman in her early 20s with light blonde hair in a loose claw-clip updo and minimal natural makeup, standing knee-deep in the spring in a secure off-white towel wrap. She looks into the distance with relaxed confidence; one arm lifts her hair while the other holds the wrap closed.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 slightly low eye-level side-profile framing. Keep the adult subject centered in the spring with large rocks, rising steam, a bamboo-pattern fence, misty mountain silhouettes, and a roof eave visible. The towel must remain securely wrapped with no exposed intimate areas.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft overcast natural daylight, steam haze, muted warm skin against cool mountain mist, quiet serene travel atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone travel photo, 50mm-equivalent lens, vertical 3:4, natural skin texture and water droplets, gentle depth separation, realistic stone and steam, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 3:4 smartphone travel portrait of one generic approved adult woman in her early 20s standing knee-deep in an outdoor mountain hot spring, light blonde loose updo with a claw clip, minimal natural makeup, securely wrapped in an off-white bath towel held closed with both hands, calm side profile looking into the misty distance, one arm lifting her hair, large rocks, rising steam, bamboo-pattern fence, misty mountains and roof eave, soft overcast daylight, warm water and cool-air contrast, serene natural wellness-travel mood, realistic skin and water texture, no logos, no watermark.
